quote: Tate presented 'Symbols in Arithmetic' at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Nice in 1970
note: The conjecture was presented by John Tate at the 1970 International Congress of Mathematicians in Nice, with proceedings published in 1971. Bryan John Birch and John Tate are both credited with the conjecture.
